purpose: Candidate evidence-root storage preflight, recorded before the first candidate case (issue #110 storage directive)

determination.evidence: The --out-dir argument of benchmarks.inferswarm_110.chain_runner and .last_stage_service is a pure CLI storage destination for evidence files (capture bundles, decision rows, case summaries). It is not part of the frozen producer identity: it does not appear in any frozen constant, methodology hash, execution-math path, or evidence-content hash (file contents hash the case/row/capture bytes, not their location). Changing the output root changes neither producer bytes at 7e5c852163afd9aadfccc406be267e8d060e79ef nor any correctness-bearing execution semantics. No symlink, bind mount, or indirection is used.

candidate_evidence_roots.role: candidate stages 1-2 (GPU-0 [0,16), GPU-1 [16,32)) + chain case summaries
candidate stage-3/last-stage capture bundles + decision-<i>.f32 rows

locality_proof: lsblk + findmnt on both hosts: /srv/models is /dev/sda1 ext4 rw,noatime on a physically local TEAM T2532TB SATA SSD (bus-attached block device, no NFS/CIFS/sshfs/fuse entries in /proc/mounts for these paths).
notes: Root-filesystem constraint that motivated this preflight: the reference run on inferswarm04 measures ~90.8 MB/case apparent (capture bundle dominates and scales with prompt length regime: mean 23.5 MB regime-01 to 131.3 MB regime-04). Candidate on 01 with the same retention would project ~129 GB against 164 GB free on its 220 GB root SSD - fits but tight; the directive to use the local 2 TB SSDs removes the risk. Paths frozen; no relocation after candidate execution begins. Reference evidence remains at /srv/inferswarm/state/issue110/reference on inferswarm04 (root SSD, ~78 GB remaining to write, 106 GB free - completes with ~28 GB headroom).
